oftentimes it happens, when,love.
breaks us, we think, we know all about
love.
put, believe me, there’s so much more,
you come to know, about love, after it
breaks you. and there’s so much more,
you're left to fathom about the ache.
that’s how we get to know the world.
the. pain. it. holds.
author: Mohit Yenugwar
